description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Urban Retreat by paying {2} and returning a tapped creature you control from the battlefield to its owner's hand, putting Urban Retreat from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Urban Retreat enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Choose not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Insect, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Urban Retreat from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Scorched Ruins.
Repeat.
